title: Covariance in Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $F$ be a complex Fourier system on finite sets $Ω$ and $ι$, with a full-support probability law and an orthonormal basis containing the constant-one function at a distinguished index $i_0$. For any complex-valued functions $f,g$ on $Ω$, their covariance under the law of $F$ equals $\sum_{i\in ι,\ i\ne i_0}\overline{\widehat f(i)}\,\widehat g(i)$, where $\widehat f(i)$ and $\widehat g(i)$ are their coefficients in the chosen basis.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a complex Fourier system on finite sets $Ω$ and $ι$
The probability law of $F$ has full support
The basis of $F$ is orthonormal and includes the constant-one function at its distinguished index
